Container.Name: Spinmatch
Container.Overview:
Search MusicBrainz for an artist, album, or song, browse album art and tracklists, and get a YouTube link for a track, verified by cross-checking the video's duration against the MusicBrainz-recorded track length. Spinmatch only finds and verifies YouTube links; it does not download or rip audio itself. It can also identify and organize a local folder of unsorted audio files via acoustic fingerprinting (AcoustID/Chromaprint), tagging and moving confirmed tracks into your music library.
Requires a free MusicBrainz-compatible contact email (set below) and, for the optional local library ingest feature, a free AcoustID API key from https://acoustid.org/new-application.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web UI listens on

Config.Name: Ingest Directory
Config.Description: Drop-folder for unsorted audio (loose files or whole album folders) to be identified and filed into Music Directory. Only used if MB Contact Email, AcoustID API Key, and this path are all set. Leave the AcoustID API Key blank to disable this feature entirely.

Config.Name: Music Directory
Config.Description: Your organized music library. Confirmed ingested tracks are moved here into an {Artist}/{Album}/{Track} - {Title} structure. Point this at your existing music share.

Config.Name: Library DB Directory
Config.Description: Storage for the SQLite library index (library.db) that powers the collection dashboard and album gap detection. Must be a persistent, mounted path so the index survives container rebuilds.

Config.Name: MB Contact Email
Config.Description: Required: a real contact email, per the MusicBrainz API usage policy (https://musicbrainz.org/doc/MusicBrainz_API/Rate_Limiting). Every request identifies itself with this address; MusicBrainz may block the app's IP without it.

Config.Name: MB App Name
Config.Description: Application name sent in the MusicBrainz User-Agent header.

Config.Name: MB App Version
Config.Description: Application version sent in the MusicBrainz User-Agent header.

Config.Name: MeTube URL
Config.Description: Optional: base URL of a MeTube instance (https://github.com/alexta69/metube), e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8081. When set, a "Send to MeTube" button appears next to YouTube results. Leave blank to hide it. Requests go straight from your browser to this URL, so your MeTube instance must allow cross-origin requests from wherever Spinmatch is hosted.

Config.Name: AcoustID API Key
Config.Description: Optional: enables the local library ingest feature (also requires Ingest Directory and Music Directory above). Get a free key at https://acoustid.org/new-application. Leave blank to hide the Ingest page entirely.

Config.Name: Library DB Path
Config.Description: Path (inside the container) to the SQLite library index. Should point into Library DB Directory above so it persists across container rebuilds. The collection dashboard is enabled automatically whenever Music Directory is set.

Config.Name: YTDLP Path
Config.Description: Path/name of the yt-dlp binary. The image installs yt-dlp on PATH already; only change this if you've customized the container.

Config.Name: FPCALC Path
Config.Description: Path/name of the fpcalc (Chromaprint) binary used for acoustic fingerprinting. The image installs it on PATH already; only change this if you've customized the container.
